exit_reason: Hit revised trim trigger ($3.30 from peer-comparison journal). Closed full position rather than partial because (1) Hormuz crisis was the unmodelled driver of the +4% intraday move - a non-thesis windfall, (2) Trump-Iran resolution risk over the weekend would gap PUMP back to $17 with IV crush stacked on top, (3) earnings 5 May = binary event 1 day after our forced exit anyway, (4) original entry rating was C+ for size+DTE+IV concerns - taking the win restores discipline.
win_relative_to_plan: Peer-comparison journal predicted realistic outcome by 4 May = breakeven to +$320. Actual outcome 1 trading day later = +$808 = 2.5x the upper bound. Exit was 5 trading days earlier than the forced close-by date.
unmodelled_drivers: Strait of Hormuz blockade (Iran/US) - WTI to ~$100 from ~$94, not in any pillar score
USO +4.87% on the day, LBRT +4.13%, PUMP +4.48% - oil-beta proxy move not earnings positioning
